mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for equities, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 9.0%, it signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer confidence and corporate earnings prospects, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 9.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high unemployment (UNRATE > 9.0%) and weak job growth (PAYEMS growth rate < 0.1% month-over-month) signals a severe labor market contraction that depresses consumer spending and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (UNRATE>9.0% and PAYEMS growth<0.1% m/m), or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-recession recovery regime, a sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST > 580 thousand units) signals strengthening consumer demand and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 580 and the regime is post-recession, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO > 95.0) indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 95.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the core consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0% year-over-year, it signals accelerating inflation that may prompt monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-interest-rate regime (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), a rising core inflation rate (CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.0%) signals potential monetary tightening, which causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.0%, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95.0, it indicates a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.
